purpose: Academic submission bundle for FloodRoute HCMC

derived: edges.csv aggregates shortest road paths from the frozen UTraffic road snapshot
assumption: scenarios.json weights and BALANCED cost preset
20 km/h connector speed for landmark-to-road display connectors

limitations: Flood risk 0 means NO_RECORD in selected sources, not flood-safe.
Graph has 65 nodes and 283 directed edges, with up to four nearest outgoing alternatives per landmark.
Normal, flood and congestion scenarios are available; flood/congestion values are ASSUMPTION demonstrations.
Hard closure applies to exact landmark edge IDs and does not propagate to overlapping aggregate edges or source segments.
Academic visualization only; not navigation or safety guidance.
